name: Piza ē Vino @ Hartenbos
description_short: Italian favourites with waterfront charm at Hartenbos, perfect for relaxed seaside dining in Mossel Bay.
description_long:
Nestled in the coastal village of Hartenbos, Piza ē Vino brings authentic Italian flavours to Mossel Bay's beachside community. The name says it all – wood-fired pizzas and carefully selected wines take centre stage, served in a relaxed atmosphere that captures the easy-going spirit of the Garden Route coast.

The menu focuses on honest Italian classics done well, from stone-baked pizzas with generous toppings to pasta dishes that satisfy without pretence. It's the kind of neighbourhood spot where locals gather for a midweek meal or weekend lunch, with the sea breeze and Hartenbos charm adding to the experience. Whether you're after a quick bite after the beach or a leisurely dinner with a glass of wine, the laid-back vibe makes everyone feel welcome.
